info.name: Coveo Activity Activities Catalog Configurations API

params.name: organizationId
params.description:
The unique identifier of the target [organization](https://docs.coveo.com/en/185/).
**Example:** `acmecorporation8tp8wu3`

params.name: configurationId
params.description:
The unique identifier of the catalog configuration to show.
**Example:** `644e1dd7-2a7f-18fb-b8ed-ed78c3f92c2b`

items.docs:
Shows a catalog configuration in an [organization](https://docs.coveo.com/en/185/).

**Required privilege:** Catalogs - View

Privilege required ``` {"owner":"COMMERCE","targetDomain":"CATALOG","type":"VIEW","targetId":"*"} ```

**Example:** `acmecorporation8tp8wu3`
